title: The Tuition and Fee Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Published tuition, mandatory fees, residency rates, and academic-year dates. The Tuition and Fee Database records published tuition and mandatory fees by institution, student level, residency status, and academic year, with payment deadlines and installment-plan options where published. Records separate tuition from the fees that stack on top of it. The Signature side adds total-cost calculators that add the commonly missed fees.
capabilities: Record tuition by institution, level, residency, and year
Separate tuition from mandatory and optional fees
Document payment deadlines and installment plans
Calculate true totals including commonly missed fees
Track year-over-year changes per institution
